spec: docs/search_efficiency_plan.md §7.12 (origin/claude/cpu-spec-improvements-yw91jd @ c4bc90a; ledger 2+312; n_loop_ops seed row 'hand-infer' 3001000-3002999)

inputs.net: nrel_r13d.npz (both seats, SeatSpec(None) = 160 sims, default budget, worlds 1 = generation yardstick)
inputs.games: 2000 (seed 3001000-3002999, random leaders x synth_roles, p1 always first)

files: n1_results/hand_infer/rows.jsonl.gz (one line per game: rows with public features, pool, known, truth)

1_card_presence_logloss_brier_gain_vs_hy.what: P(card kind k >= 1 in opponent hand), per (decision point, kind in remaining pool); gain = (baseline - model)/baseline, holdout

3_top10_features_card_logreg_std_coef: counter value x counter value opp used this turn
has-counter card x counters opp used this turn
counter value x counters opp used this turn

prediction_check.logloss_gain_5_to_15pct: met at the low end: +6.0% (logreg) / +6.7% (MLP) on seat A
prediction_check.larger_from_turn3_with_unplayed_features: direction met (turn1-2 ~0, turn3-4 +4.2, turn5+ +6.6), but the cause is mostly NOT the 'did not play' features: dropping them costs only ~0.5 pt (5.99 -> 5.46); the bulk (4.6 of 6.0 pt) is publicly revealed cards entering the hand (search 'reveal and add', bounce, trash->hand), which accumulate with turns
prediction_check.counter_auc_0.6_to_0.7: missed in form: holding >=1 counter card is 95.5% base rate and the hypergeometric alone already ranks it at AUC 0.90 (pool size/composition), learned 0.92. The informative version (>=1 2000-counter) is 0.80 -> 0.83

notes: Branch base: 'mainline' taken as origin/claude/cpu-spec-improvements-yw91jd @ c4bc90a (it contains origin/main plus the newer code with r13d / PLAY_WORLDS); no code under opcg_sim/ or rust/ was changed.

Seat A = p1 (always first player with first_player=None). Rows were also written from p2's point of view in the same games (column 'me'); metrics are reported for seat A (primary, as specified) and for both seats. They agree within ~0.3 pt.
Turn bands use the game turn counter (Game.turn_count, both players' turns counted), so seat A rows are on odd turns: '1-2' = seat A's 1st turn, '3-4' = 2nd, '5+' = 3rd onward.

Model (b) is ONE logistic regression shared across card kinds (not one per card id): with random leaders x synth decks the 2,803 card ids are too sparse for per-id models. Inputs: logit of the hypergeometric probability, card attributes (counter, counter event, cost, type, blocker, removal, trigger), row features, and interactions (counter attributes x 'did not counter' stats; affordable-at-turn-end x unused DON; etc.) = 100 columns, standardized, L2=1, Newton. (c) MLP: 1 hidden layer of 32, numpy Adam, 6 epochs, output added to the hypergeometric logit.

Hypergeometric baseline pool = opponent deck list minus cards in public zones (field, stage, trash, face-up life). Unseen = deck + hand + face-down life. 0 truth cards fell outside the pool; hand_count matched hidden in all 145,203 rows.

Public-only features: the board dict also contains the opponent hand and face-down life, which are NOT read; SELECT_COUNTER's selectable_uuids (visible only to the defender) are NOT read. Game.hidden_json is used only for the truth and to resolve the uuid of a card whose name was publicly shown in an event (reveal 'name(abcd)' -> uuid). Known-in-hand tracking was correct for 99.45% of tracked cards (47,140/47,400; misses = cards moved hand->deck/life by non-public effects).

'Did not play' features: per my attack, whether the opponent countered (and value), attacker-minus-defender margin at the counter window, whether a single 1000/2000 counter would have saved a leader hit; opponent's unused active DON / hand / plays / played cost / events at its last TURN_END; mulligan. Their standalone contribution is small (+0.5 pt overall, +0.6 pt at turn 3-4). Mulligan never appears in the top features.

Counter 'value sum' counts printed (symbol) counters only; counter events are counted as holding a counter for the AUC but their value is not in the sum. 'has_counter' = symbol counter > 0 or a 【カウンター】 event.
Role buckets are exclusive with priority removal > blocker > counter > other (removal = deck_roles.classify non-empty, which includes lock/reduce).
turn1-2 logreg is slightly worse than baseline (-0.9%): nothing beyond the hypergeometric is knowable then and the shared model mis-shifts; the MLP is ~0.
Learned gains on train vs holdout are close (logreg 6.95 vs 5.99, MLP 8.38 vs 6.69) = mild overfit for the MLP only.
Rows with opponent hand 0 are dropped from the analysis (145,203 recorded -> 141,213 used).

1 of 2000 games aborted (seed 3002397, step 94: apply_game_action raised 'unknown action DON_BOX' — decide returned a macro move the apply path did not accept). Its rows up to the abort are kept. This looks like an engine/driver bug outside this WP; not investigated further.

The first analyze run was killed by the container (memory); the analysis was rewritten to keep the 2.49M x 100 design in float32 and fit Newton in chunks (peak well under the limit, 113 s). Numbers did not change on the small test file.

Interpretation for search: the cheap, large win is exact bookkeeping of publicly revealed cards in the opponent's hand (determinization currently reshuffles the whole hand + deck); learned 'behavioural' inference adds only ~1.4 pt logloss on top and ~6% MAE on the counter sum.
